items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution this cycle and reject the CRO/product candidate plan for new production work. Evidence: the authoritative candidate list is empty; 198 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failure follow-ups remain open, 29 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed; ROI, margin, and causal lift remain unknown. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close, and legal/security evidence work. Smallest next step: complete those existing artifacts. Owner decision: authorize the prepared Woot permission request only after human-counsel review, or keep it unsent.

Handoff: preserve useful CRO and product concepts as deferred backlog only. No new experiments, dependencies, telemetry, GitHub adoption, or change requests are justified while failed-work containment, measurement backlog, and security gates remain open. Continue existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, bounded legal/security evidence, and repair-or-close review.
